source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Individualized nutritional support, potentially including small, frequent, calorie-dense meals and consultation with a registered dietitian","B":"Fairly little specific nutritional intervention actually being helpful for a client experiencing this degree of unintentional weight loss","C":"Restricting the client's caloric intake in an effort to prevent further complications from developing during treatment","D":"A single, universal high-calorie diet plan applied in the same way to every client affected by this condition"}}
source_row.rationale: Nutritional support for cancer cachexia includes individualized approaches, potentially including small, frequent, calorie-dense meals and consultation with a registered dietitian, addressing the complex metabolic changes involved in this condition, which is not simply managed by increased intake alone.
